Name: Flexible Upgrades
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b]Flexible Upgrades[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4]Multi-finish for Robin and Clint. Complete several buildings and upgrades at once for a fee. Fully configurable.[/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53846/53846-1791921611-966949781.png[/img][/center]
[line]
[center][b][color=#8e7cc3][size=6]Features[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Finish Early[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Robin[/b] - Finish a building, house upgrade, or community upgrade early, from her shop dialogue. (available even when she's working on a building.)[/*]
[*][b]Clint[/b] - Finish a tool upgrade early, from his shop dialogue. Ready extras are collected from his counter one per visit, like the normal tool.[/*]
[*]Each option lists its price and days left.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Multiple Orders[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Robin & Clint [/b]- Start a new order while another runs. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on, max 3)[/color][/*]
[*]Upgrade and Construct entries show [used / max] slots.[/*]
[*]At the cap, Clint and Robin list each open job and its days left instead of accepting more.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Pricing[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Formula: base + (per day x days left) + (factor x price)[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Prices drop as days pass.[/*]
[*][b]Robin[/b] - Base fee [color=#b4a7d6](default: 100)[/color], per-day fee [color=#b4a7d6](default: 600)[/color], building factor [color=#b4a7d6](default: 0.6)[/color].[/*]
[*][b]Clint[/b] - Base fee [color=#b4a7d6](default: 100)[/color], per-day fee [color=#b4a7d6](default: 400)[/color], upgrade factor [color=#b4a7d6](default: 0.4)[/color].[/*]
[*]Building and tool prices come from game data, so rebalances and custom content work.[/*]
[*][color=#ea9999]House upgrades (10,000 / 65,000 / 100,000) and community upgrades (500,000 / 300,000) have no data entries, so those numbers are fixed.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Each player pays their own gold and collect their own tools.[/*]
[*]Buildings states get synced with the host then with other players.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][b][size=5]API[/size][/b][/color]
[spoiler]Flexible Upgrades registers a SMAPI API under the mod ID [font=Consolas]yousv.FlexibleUpgrades[/font]. Other mods can access it via [font=Consolas]IModRegistry.GetApi[/font].
[list]
[*][b]GetRobinProjects()[/b] - Open jobs as kind, name, days left, building id.[/*]
[*][b]GetToolOrders()[/b] - Upgrades as display name, days left, item id, vanilla flag.[/*]
[/list]Usage example:
[code]
var api = helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<IFlexibleUpgradesApi>("yousv.FlexibleUpgrades");
if (api != null)
{
var orders = api.GetToolOrders();
}[/code][b]The API is read-only.[/b][/spoiler]
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[/list]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration. Without it, edit the config.json file directly.
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
